items.headline: AI stocks lead a rebound on Wall Street as European markets drop following protests
items.summary: Nvidia rose 1.3% and helped lift the S&P 500 as AI stocks recovered part of the prior week’s losses. The report also said borrowing costs remain a concern for AI-chip and data-center spending.

items.headline: Defiance renames AMOM as AIED and adds an LLM-based news signal
items.summary: Defiance ETFs announced that the QRAFT AI-Enhanced U.S. Large Cap Momentum ETF became the Defiance LLM Catalyst Momentum ETF and began trading under ticker AIED. The strategy combines momentum factors with real-time AI analysis of company-specific news.

items.headline: Tech stocks rebound as AI confidence returns
items.summary: A market update reported gains in semiconductor and technology shares, including Micron, Sandisk and Intel, while Amazon benefited from cloud optimism. Investors were focused on upcoming earnings and whether AI capital spending can generate adequate returns.
